errors.evidence: The categories on the x-axis are sorted in descending order of their corresponding values, not in alphabetical order. For example, 'Schweden' (Sweden) comes before 'Deutschland' (Germany).
The bar for Schweden (Sweden) is closer to 75%, as indicated by the reference description and the grid line on the chart.

The value for Italien (Italy) is approximately 47%, the same as Polen (Poland), not 48%.
